messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for inference-latency (route: /v1/generate, region: ap-south-1). p99 = 1.92s (SLO 1.2s). Queue depth spike on inference-queue-34. PD incident: PD#12345.
oncall-maya: acked. I'm on it, pulling dashboards now.
jamal: looking at traces — high tail on decode stage, many requests waiting for batch window.
lucy: seeing a big increase in inflight requests from router-ap-south-2, ~3x baseline. Any recent rollout?
jamal: no recent deploys in the last hour. Autoscaler shows no new nodes yet, pods saturated CPU ~95%.
product-sam: customers in APAC might see slow responses, flagging CS.
oncall-maya: quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce batching window, 2) scale replica count on the inference pool, 3) shift a fraction of traffic to rw-7b-lite as a fallback.
sre-ian: agree. Reducing batch window first to minimize queueing. Jamal, I can run the scale.
jamal: doing step 1 now — pushing config change to batcher: `BATCH_MAX_LATENCY_MS=8 -> 4` (quick restart).
oncall-maya: step 2 command ready:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-pool-ap-south --replicas=12
```
jamal: scaled to 12, pods coming up. CPU utilization should drop in ~30s.
lucy: starting a 10% route weight shift to rw-7b-lite to shed heavy tails:
```
sh ./ops/traffic-shift.sh --from inference-prod --to rw-7b-lite --percent 10 --region ap-south-1
```
product-sam: posted a short note to CS channel: "APAC latency spike, mitigations in progress, updates in ~10min"
oncall-maya: monitoring dashboards — p99 dropped to 1.35s after scaling and batch change, still above SLO but trending down.
sre-ian: I'll keep an eye on replica readiness and node pressure. If CPU stays high, we should increase node pool or enable burst capacity.
jamal: checking request queue histograms — backlog shrinking. No obvious hotkeys. KV cache hit rate steady.
lucy: PagerDuty status: PD#12345 still open, not escalated. Anyone want to handoff after next update?
oncall-maya: I'll stay for the next 20m and then hand off to Jamal if stable.
product-sam: will update customer bulletin when we confirm p99 < 1.2s for two consecutive 5m windows.
incident-bot: Incident note appended: "Scale + batch window reduction + 10% fallback to rw-7b-lite".
oncall-maya: current p99 = 1.18s, marking progress. If it holds, prepare to close the PD in 15m.
sre-ian: filing a follow-up runbook item: investigate autoscaler thresholding for sudden queue bursts.
jamal: thanks all. leaving logs + traces at https://internal.logs/redwood/PD12345 for postmortem.
oncall-maya: handing off in 18m if stable. :thumbsup:
